why: Momentum on a wheel turn is MANA: 82% of the champion's goldfish stall turns are mana-short (5,299 of 6,493). Two Treasure makers that pay slowly or pay an opponent too are swapped for rituals that fund a wheel and its follow-up in one turn; Smothering Tithe and Sticky Fingers stay. Plus Teferi's Protection, asked for by the pilot 2026-10-02: Shelter and two boots are the deck's whole protection for a commander pair the engine cannot run without. THE GOLDFISH CANNOT PRICE ANY OF THIS: rituals are not modelled (a spell that adds mana produces 0), Treasure modelling is off because 4 of 5 makers are unreadable, and Mana Geyser counts opponents' tapped lands, which a one-seat goldfish has none of. FORGE IS THE INSTRUMENT, after the edgar A/A frees the machine.
